claims.claim: Independent Korean industry reporting says LG Innotek and Aeva are moving beyond LG Innotek's equity investment into an operating manufacturing partnership spanning the Omni short-range lidar and Atlas Ultra long-range lidar programs.

The report says LG Innotek plans to manufacture Omni for full production in 2027 after second-half-2026 validation/trial shipments, and Atlas Ultra for mass production targeted in 2028, providing an independent execution signal for Aeva's disclosed manufacturing roadmap.

risks: The production dates remain forward-looking and depend on customer validation, qualification and manufacturing execution.
The independent report does not disclose committed unit volumes, unit economics or guaranteed revenue.

contradictions.contradiction: Independent reporting supports the disclosed production roadmap but does not resolve the existing gap between program breadth and disclosed scaled economics.

unknowns: Committed Omni and Atlas Ultra production volumes and economics.
Whether second-half-2026 Omni trial shipments have converted into binding production orders.

claims.claim: As of September 27, 2026, Seoul Economic Daily reported that Aeva's Omni remained on a path to full production in 2027 following customer validation and trial shipments in the second half of 2026, while LG Innotek described the Aeva collaboration as proceeding as planned.

The same independent report places Atlas Ultra mass production in 2028 with LG Innotek handling production, creating a dated external checkpoint against Aeva's longer-range automotive execution expectations.

risks: On-track status is not evidence of scaled revenue or completed qualification.
Schedule slippage or failed customer validation would falsify the near-term execution signal.

contradictions.contradiction: Manufacturing-partner confirmation strengthens execution confidence while the absence of disclosed committed volumes and economics still limits underwriting precision.

unknowns: Actual 2026 Omni trial-shipment quantities and customer identities.
Binding production commitments behind the 2027 and 2028 targets.
